data.body: fix-bug:investigation -- VERDICT: LIVE (confirmed at SHA 6734986bd9; no changes after ticket creation 2026-06-03T00:18:34Z). EXACT LOCATION: tests/scripts/test-migrate-closure-checks.sh line 989 (trap overwrites git-fixtures _cleanup) and line 1001 (trap - clears all traps including _cleanup). ROOT CAUSE: bash EXIT trap replacement semantics -- second trap overwrites first; _restore_real_classifier then clears all. FIX APPROACH: use trap -p EXIT idiom from tests/run-all.sh lines 72-96: capture prior trap in _PRIOR_EXIT_TRAP_BEFORE_CLASSIFIER before overriding; in _restore_real_classifier restore saved trap instead of trap - EXIT. ERR/INT/TERM can be cleared outright. RED TEST PLAN: run test file, verify _CLEANUP_DIRS temp dirs are deleted on exit (RED=dirs persist; GREEN=dirs gone). SIBLING DEFECTS (note only): test-retro-gather-suggestions.sh lines 75/102/128 each overwrite git-fixtures _cleanup (3 sequential clobbers); test-audit-source-consumers.sh line 39 trap is clobbered by git-fixtures line 50. FEASIBILITY: yes.
